lines.t: You know the parts I never spoke
Held back until my floodgates broke
False skies took me far away from your grace
That I know today now
Teachers make me clench my jaw
Oh, fears, they stand alone, be small
You heard my breath go quick and thin
Still bruised from where fake shepherds bend
You didn't scold my trembling knees
You didn't wait for me to plead
My heart was stirred at your roar
I recognize and fear no more
You sent the lions, I braced for teeth
But you gave rain where the drought ran deep
Your shelter in the height of heat
It is the sound of your heart beating
You sent the lines, they don't want pay
Like doves, they sing your song all day
You, just you, made my hands unclench
I can lean now
I don't have to flinch
I don't have to flinch
You saw the tears I tried to hide
Found scattered where the wild weed lies
You're fine and broken, your tears we cried
A ten year drought broke wide inside
You must've smiled to watch me cause
And how I checked for the hidden cause
You know I'm learning inch by inch
That being held is not being lost
You didn't scold my trembling knees
You didn't wait for me to plead
My heart was stirred at your roar
I recognize and feel no more
You sent the lions, I missed fatigue
But you gave rain where the drought ran deep
Your shelter in the height of heat
It is the sound of your heartbeat
You sent the lines, they don't want pay
Like doves, they sing your song all day
Just you made my hands unclench
I can lean now, I don't have to flinch
You can keep this, just you and me
You saw the panic, none could see
12,000 sealed from every try
12 times, 12,000 at my side
You sent the lions, I braced for tea
But you gave rain where the drought ran deep
Your shelter in the height of heat
It is the sound of your heartbeat
You sent the lies, they don't want pay
Like does they sing your song all day?
You, just you, made my hands unclench
I can lean now, I don't have to flinch
You sent them here
You stayed right here
You sent them here
Your second half is found in me
You sit down here
You stay right here
You sit down here
Your second half is found in me
